## 型

### Console

```emela
effect Console
```

Writes a line to standard output (`print_line`) or standard error (`print_error_line`).

- `fn print_line(text: String) -> ()`
- `fn print_error_line(text: String) -> ()`

### SystemConsole

```emela
handler SystemConsole: Console
```

Writes to the host's standard output and standard error, through the same path as SystemStdout
and SystemStderr of `Std.Process` (JS: file descriptors 1 and 2, or `console.log` and
`console.error` on a host without them; C `stdout` and `stderr`). Stateless.

### TestConsole

```emela
handler TestConsole: Console
uses { State[List[String]] }
```

The test handler (spec 8.8). It keeps the printed lines in `State[List[String]]`, so use it
inside `State.run`:

```emela
(_, lines) = State.run([], || with TestConsole { greet(1) })
assert lines == ["Hello, alice!"]
```

`print_line` appends the line in the printed order. `print_error_line` drops the line.
